brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base only, no pieces beside or on top (one cell at level 0)
requirements.evidence: Build has 1 node: piece:0,0,0;half-n only at q=0,r=0,level=0. No neighbors at level 0 or level 1. check_build ok meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Five drawers in that single base
requirements.evidence: Configurator offers at most 1 drawer socket per half base (half-n: slot s, half-s: slot n) and 0 for full/quarter variants. find_sockets drawer total=1. Attempting second drawer returns ALREADY_FITTED; multi-storey returns HOST_MISMATCH requiring stacked half bases which would violate single-base requirement. Max achievable within constraints is 1 drawer, not 5.

finish.summary: Build is single half-n base alone (verified clear). Five drawers impossible: system enforces 1 drawer per half-base cell; no option for 5 was offered after exhaustive variant tests. Requirement reported as unmet.
